5670.title: [M157] Sync upstream Skia chrome/m157 bug fixes
5670.body:
[M157] Sync upstream Skia chrome/m157 bug fixes (#5670)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/440
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5674
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/cd151a3c30953e87a673d9840ad1e525667b46ee...24c21cc82f1f03e03740b742309c7a5e0d50beb3

Bring the m157 rendering and Vulkan fixes into release/4.157.x without
changing managed APIs, generated bindings, or package versions.

~~ Correct reflected hairline square caps ~~

Negative-determinant transforms incorrectly took a unit local-space
fallback when constructing square caps on zero-length hairlines,
allowing scaling to enlarge them arbitrarily. Use the signed inverse
determinant for the half-pixel outset and suppress non-finite results.

~~ Stabilize text atlas selection ~~

Ganesh's flat-interpolation hint does not guarantee integral atlas
indices. Round the interpolated index before converting to int in
ordinary and LCD texture selection to avoid sampling the wrong atlas.

~~ Respect affected Mali device-loss cleanup timing ~~

Ganesh and Graphite delay affected device-loss cleanup paths by 1 ms
for ARM proprietary Vulkan driver versions >=42 and <56. These drivers
can return from waits before device destruction is safe.

~~ Record landed native ancestry without changing reviewed content ~~

Update externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to
24c21cc82f1f03e03740b742309c7a5e0d50beb3. Record upstream chrome/m157
at 851b8fee76806e84c668d40bdaf17a6468e1ce6f.

The native merge directly contains reviewed head
aa0f7c80a0caa1d792eb63134ba938be64b6634d and has the identical tree,
125bb54f9deab6118df7a628df7c2782e9a99638. The dependent repin updates
only the gitlink and matching manifest SHA.

Azure build 1671433 succeeded on the PR merge for original source head
b2cb867d98031def80d4b381014092030fc36b81, including native builds and
managed/runtime tests. The repin retains that reviewed native content;
affected physical Mali device-loss behavior was not specifically proven.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>

5664.title: Fix Alpine apk bootstrap artifact pin
5664.body:
Use the available Alpine 3.21 apk-tools-static 2.14.13-r0 archive and its verified SHA-256. The previous 2.14.6-r3 archive now returns HTTP 404, preventing musl build images from bootstrapping.


(cherry picked from commit 55c03c000afa46e4d3b659fb80b2ae70e3af26d5)
